question: Which eminent English writer was awarded the Jnanpith Award in 2018? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Shankha Ghosh

Explanation:

question: Which state government confers the 'Basava Puraskara' award? (RRB JE ME (30/08/2019) Shift 1 CBT 2)
options: Karnataka
Andhra Pradesh
Gujarat
Maharashtra
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Karnataka

Explanation:
The Basava Puraskara is a prestigious award conferred by the Government of Karnataka. It is named after the 12th-century social reformer and philosopher Basaveshwara, who championed social equality, gender equality, and founded the Lingayat sect. The award is given annually to individuals or organizations for outstanding contributions in the fields of social justice, education, and human rights. Basaveshwara's teachings emphasized the rejection of caste discrimination and the promotion of a casteless society. The award carries a cash prize, a citation, and a memento, and is presented by the Karnataka government to honor those who work towards the ideals of Basaveshwara.

question: Name the Indian scientist who shared the Nobel Prize for Medicine and Physiology in 1968 for cracking the genetic code. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (17/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Visvesvaraya
Meghnad Saha
Har Gobind Khorana
Venkatraman Radhakrishna
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Har Gobind Khorana

Explanation:
Har Gobind Khorana was an Indian-American scientist who played a key role in cracking the genetic code. He discovered how triplets of nucleotides (codons) specify amino acids. In 1968, he shared the Nobel Prize for Medicine and Physiology with Robert W. Holley and Marshall W. Nirenberg. Khorana also synthesized the first artificial gene. His work is fundamental to molecular biology and genetics.

question: For which of the following fields did Marie Curie win the Nobel Prize? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (22/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Physics and Astronomy
Physics and Meteorology
Chemistry and Biology
Physics and Chemistry
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Physics and Chemistry

Explanation:
Marie Curie won the Nobel Prize in two different fields. She received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903 jointly with Pierre Curie and Henri Becquerel for their research on radioactivity. Later, in 1911, she won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for the discovery of the elements radium and polonium. Thus, she became the first person to win Nobel Prizes in two separate scientific fields.

question: For which discovery was Paul Ehrlich awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine in 1908? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (21/06/2025) Shift 3)
options: Antibacterial effect of sulpha drugs
Penicillin for treating infections
Use of azodyes in textiles
Theoretical basis for immunology
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Theoretical basis for immunology

Explanation:
Paul Ehrlich was awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine in 1908 for his work on the theoretical basis of immunology. He proposed the side-chain theory, which explains antibody formation and immune response. Ehrlich laid the foundation for chemotherapy and developed Salvarsan (a drug for syphilis). He also contributed to the standardization of diphtheria antitoxin. Ehrlich shared the prize with Ilya Mechnikov, who worked on phagocytosis. Thus, Ehrlich's contribution was centered on the theoretical basis of immunology.

question: Which organisation was formed by Henry Dunant, the winner of the first Nobel Peace Prize in 1901? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/02/2021) Shift 2)

Solution: सही उत्तर है प्रणब मुखर्जी

Explanation:
भारत रत्न भारत का सर्वोच्च नागरिक पुरस्कार है। वर्ष 2019 में पूर्व राष्ट्रपति प्रणब मुखर्जी को उनके असाधारण राजनीतिक जीवन और राष्ट्र सेवा के लिए इस सम्मान से अलंकृत किया गया। वे लगभग पांच दशकों तक सार्वजनिक जीवन में सक्रिय रहे और भारत के राष्ट्रपति (2012-2017) के रूप में कार्य किया। इसके अलावा, उन्होंने रक्षा, वित्त और विदेश मंत्रालयों सहित कई प्रमुख सरकारी पदों पर कार्य किया। इस पुरस्कार की घोषणा 25 जनवरी 2019 को की गई थी और यह पुरस्कार उनके योगदान को मान्यता देता है।
